relations.subject: Kashinath Narayan Dikshit
relations.evidence: Rao Bahadur Kashinath Narayan Dikshit (21 October 1889 – 12 August 1946) was an Indian archaeologist who served as Director-general of the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) from 1937 to 1944.

relations.subject: Kashinath Narayan Dikshit
relations.evidence: Post-retirement, he continued his work in museology and was actively involved with the Bhandarkar Oriental Research Institute.

relations.subject: Mortimer Wheeler
relations.evidence: Dikshit retired in 1944 and was succeeded by Sir Mortimer Wheeler.
